questions.subject: Physics
questions.text:
Match the column appropriately regarding thermodynamic process.
Column-I:
(P) When volume change is zero
(Q) When pressure is constant
(R) When no heat is exchanged
(S) Work done by the gas is equal to heat given to the gas
Column-II:
(i) $\Delta W = 0$
(ii) $\Delta Q = 0$
(iii) Isobaric
(iv) Isothermal
questions.solution:
Volume change is zero $\rightarrow$ isochoric $\rightarrow \Delta W = 0$
Isobaric $\implies \Delta P = 0$
No heat exchange (adiabatic) $\implies \Delta Q = 0$
Heat given = $\Delta W \implies \Delta U = 0 \implies \Delta T = 0$ (Isothermal)

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: A uniform solid sphere of mass $m$ rolls down from rest to achieve speed $v_1$ on an inclined plane of $30^\circ$. Sphere achieves speed $v_2$ on an inclined plane of $45^\circ$ when released from same height then $\frac{v_1^2}{v_2^2}$ is (assume no slipping)
questions.solution:
$|\Delta U| = |\Delta K| \implies mgh = \frac{1}{2}(\gamma + 1)mv^2$ where $\gamma = \frac{2}{5}$.
Here $v$ doesn't depend on $\theta$, so $\frac{v_1^2}{v_2^2} = 1$ for solid sphere.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text:
Find the equation of magnetic field for the given equation of electric field (for EM wave).
$\vec{E} = E_0 (4\hat{i} - 3\hat{j})\cos(\omega t - kz)$
questions.solution:
Phase difference of magnetic field with electric field is zero.
$|\vec{B}| = \frac{E_0}{C} \implies |\vec{B}| = \frac{E_0 \cdot 5}{C}$.
Direction of wave propagation is along $\hat{k} \parallel (\vec{E} \times \vec{B})$.
Unit vector along $\vec{B}$ is $\left(\frac{3\hat{i} + 4\hat{j}}{5}\right)$.
So $\vec{B} = \frac{E_0}{C}(3\hat{i} + 4\hat{j})\cos(\omega t - kz)$.

$\implies \omega = 100\text{ rad/s}$

questions.solution:

$273 V^{1/2} = T \left(\frac{V}{4}\right)^{1/2}$
$273 V^{1/2} = T \frac{V^{1/2}}{2}$
$\implies T = 2 \times 273 = 546\text{ K}$

questions.subject: Physics
questions.text: Two objects are equal distances from sphere of radius $R$ & refractive index $\mu$ such that the image of one object forms on other object. Find the object distance from the surface of sphere.
questions.solution:
$\frac{\mu_2}{v} - \frac{\mu_1}{u} = \frac{\mu_2 - \mu_1}{R}$
After first refraction the ray must become parallel to the line joining two objects.
So $v = \infty$
$0 - \frac{1}{-u} = \frac{\mu - 1}{R} \implies |u| = \frac{R}{\mu - 1}$

questions.text: In a radioactive decay, decay constant of element $A_2$ is 3 times that of element $A_1$. Find the ratio of nuclei of element 1 to element 2 after one half life of $A_2$ (Assume initial number of nuclei are same for both elements)
questions.solution:
$N_1 = N_0 e^{-\lambda_1 t}$, $N_2 = N_0 e^{-\lambda_2 t}$
$\frac{N_1}{N_2} = e^{(\lambda_2 - \lambda_1)t} = e^{(3\lambda_1 - \lambda_1)\frac{\ln 2}{3\lambda_1}} = e^{\frac{2}{3}\ln 2} = 2^{2/3}$

questions.text: When $10^{21}$ molecules are removed from $x\text{ mg}$ of $\text{CO}_2(g)$, then $2.4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ moles}$ of $\text{CO}_2$ are left. Calculate the value of $x$. [Take $N_A = 6 \times 10^{23}$]

Moles removed = $\frac{10^{21}}{6 \times 10^{23}} = 0.167 \times 10^{-2}\text{ mol}$

Mass = $4.07 \times 10^{-3} \times 44\text{ g} = 179\text{ mg} \implies x = 179$.

$-4 \times F \times E^\circ = -3 \times F \times 2 + (-1 \times F \times 0.8)$

questions.text: How many words can be formed from the word "DAUGHTER" such that any vowels are not together
questions.solution:
Total arrangements without restriction = $8!$
Arrangements with vowels together = $6! \times 3! = 720 \times 6 = 4320$
Wait, total words with no vowels together: $8! - 6! \times 3! = 40320 - 4320 = 36000$.

questions.text: If the curve satisfying the differential equation $\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{6 - 2e^{2x}y}{1 + e^{2x}}$ passes through $(0, 0)$ and $(\ln 2, k)$, then $k$ is
questions.solution:
$\frac{dy}{dx} + \left(\frac{2e^{2x}}{1 + e^{2x}}\right)y = \frac{6}{1 + e^{2x}}$
$\text{I.F.} = 1 + e^{2x}$
$y(1 + e^{2x}) = 6x + c$
Passes through $(0, 0) \implies c = 0$
$y = \frac{6x}{1 + e^{2x}}$
For $x = \ln 2$, $k = \frac{6\ln 2}{1 + 4} = \frac{6}{5}\ln 2$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
If $f(x)$ is continuous at $x = 0$, where
$f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{2}{x}(\sin(k_1 + 1)x + \sin(k_2 + 1)x) & x < 0 \\ 4 & x = 0 \\ \frac{2}{x}\log\left[\frac{k_2 x + 1}{k_1 x + 1}\right] & x > 0 \end{cases}$
Then $k_1^2 + k_2^2$ is
questions.solution:
$\lim_{x \rightarrow 0^-} f(x) = 2(k_1 + 1 + k_2 + 1) = 4 \implies k_1 + k_2 = 0$
$\lim_{x \rightarrow 0^+} f(x) = 2(k_2 - k_1) = 4 \implies k_2 - k_1 = 2$
Solving gives $k_1 = -1, k_2 = 1 \implies k_1^2 + k_2^2 = 2$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If the equation $a(b - c)x^2 + b(c - a)x + c(a - b) = 0$ has equal roots and if $a + c = 5$ and $b = \frac{16}{5}$, then the value of $a^2 + c^2$ is equal to
questions.solution:
Clearly $x = 1$ is a root $\implies$ other root is also 1.
Product of roots = $1 \implies \frac{c(a - b)}{a(b - c)} = 1 \implies 2ac = b(a + c) = \frac{16}{5}(5) = 16$.
$a^2 + c^2 = (a + c)^2 - 2ac = 25 - 16 = 9$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The area of larger portion enclosed by curves $y = |x - 1|$ and $x^2 + y^2 = 25$ is equal to $\frac{1}{4}(\alpha\pi + \beta)\text{ sq. units}$ (where $\alpha, \beta$ are natural numbers), then $\alpha + \beta$ equals to
questions.solution:
Area = $25\pi - \int_{-3}^4 (\sqrt{25 - x^2} - |x - 1|) dx = \frac{1}{4}(75\pi + 2)$
$\alpha = 75, \beta = 2 \implies \alpha + \beta = 77$.
